contract: One rule per cross-component domain, naming the exact records and facts it reasons over, its conditions, a conditioned refusal, and a verdict limited to NEEDS BENCH or UNSOURCED. Conditioned calculations recompute from raw fact values on every run. The domains listed in component-spec-audit/references/schema.json integration_domains must match this file exactly.

rules.conditions: Current chain: Board P nominal 15 V / 3 A -> AP63201 +13.44 V, LM2596 +6.519 V and -14.145 V intermediates -> LT1963A +12/+5 V and LT3015-12 -12 V. R5/R6 are 10.5 k/1 k 0.1%; tolerance/TCR/reference calculations are screening, with actual low-line dropout, ripple and thermal coupling open. Board A and original regulator facts are historical and are not current-stage proof. Prototype normal source envelope is15 V±5%,20 V unsupported; first power/programming uses5 V-only with B disconnected and retained15 V-only NVM readback before a PD-capable source.
rules.refusal: Do not certify regulated output or the 26.5 W rated total until all three outputs pass low-line, full-load, ripple and thermal tests with the programmed PD core.

rules.conditions: U4 local GND/ON-OFF/tab ride the renewed negative intermediate. Normal prototype input is15 V±5%;20 V is unsupported. Effective input and D3 reverse stress are VBUS plus negative magnitude:29.145 V nominal,30.564410 V at15.75 V and the14.814410 V hot/TCR screen,40.814410 V at the conditioned26 V TVS point. New D3 has60 V reverse rating and maximum0.52 V at5 A/25C (0.45 V at5 A/125C); use0.52 V for the25C conduction screen, without extrapolating a full-temperature ceiling. C9 is50 V. CCM input-current/loss calculations include25C winding DCR, while hot DCR, switching/core/quiescent losses, ringing and startup remain open. Reverse leakage is0.5 mA maximum at60 V/25C and50 mA typical only at60 V/125C; the latter is not a guaranteed hot leakage bound. Reverse-leakage heating remains outside the forward-conduction model and requires qualification.
rules.refusal: Do not infer surge or startup acceptance from normal DC margin; preserve the negative rail, floating ground and semiconductor stress calculations after every setpoint change.

rules.conditions: LT1963A replaces both positive regulators and LT3015-12 replaces the negative regulator. AP pre-rail arithmetic is 13.219794..13.6624 V with the selected resistor/TCR envelope. Negative minimum is 13.483572 V with full-temperature reference and 0.35% combined resistor tolerance/TCR, leaving 0.483572 V above the fixed-12 input guarantee boundary before ripple. LT1963A adjustment-bias maximum is only specified at 25C; do not extrapolate it as a full-temperature limit. Include load-dependent ground current in thermal screens and verify output capacitor ESR/effective capacitance.

rules.conditions: The current P-to-B interface is XFCN male JOUT1 to female J5: paired power pins 1/2, ATT 3, PDOK 4 and paired GND 5/6. Each contact nameplate is 3 A; paired contacts do not raise the 3 A PD contract. The unkeyed mechanical stack and actual temperature rise must be verified. Historical JST XH Board A does not directly mate.
rules.refusal: Do not promote contact nameplate arithmetic to installed capability without correct mating orientation, retained board support and full-load thermal measurement.

rules.conditions: Board P routed geometry and current generated schematics have distinct evidence from incoming-part orientation, assembled boards, programmed NVM and measured behavior. rules.conditions: J6.1 GND/J6.2 -12V and J7.1 +5V/J7.2 +12V are separate poles. Retaining an old same-node Faston link would deterministically short distinct rails, not create an acceptable bench assumption. Whole-board targets +12V/1.2A,+5V/0.5A,-12V/0.8A are shared with J10/J11. The2.5A sum-of-magnitudes return screen adds no capacity; no18A per-output board claim is established. Mirrored UL15A/300V and IEC18A/250V ratings are conditional terminal ratings. Actual wire, torque, solder process,1.30mm finished-hole fit, loaded temperature and retention remain unverified. Model tails3.50mm do not establish physical4.50±.20mm tail clearance; use4.70mm conservative geometry and retain physical qualification as open.
rules.refusal: Do not preserve old same-net links between the two new poles: that would short distinct rails. Do not certify18A per output from a terminal rating or visual model; verify polarity, wire retention, process, hole fit and loaded temperature within shared board targets.
